about: The kinds of operational problems (#5509, canvas problem-kinds v3 of #5464). Each fault gets one kind before an agent starts, by eight rules in order with no model, and the kind decides what happens. It ships with MaximizePM and holds nothing about any one project; a project adds its own known messages in its system description (maxpm ops system edit <project> --set rules.known_messages="<kind>: <text>").
rules: 1 broken check: the check itself failed: its command exited UNKNOWN (3), timed out or did not start, or its output names a known message of the kind broken check (it could not reach its host)
2 noise: a noise rule of the check matches (maxpm ops noise)
3 planned: a check of the same scope is paused at that time (maxpm ops pause)
4 outside dependency: a check of layer dependency of the same project or target is in fault
5 a lower layer failed first: a check of layer capacity or service of the same project or target went to fault before this fault's first failed run; the kind is that check's
6 a known message: the output names a text of the known messages (the project's own first, then these)
7 release regression: the first failed run came within the release window after a release, and this fault did not occur in the 30 days before the release
8 unknown: nothing matched; one short sorting session gives the kind and adds the rule that would have found it

broken-check.name: broken check
broken-check.signs: exit UNKNOWN, a timeout of the command, an SSH or network error of the check
broken-check.proof: the check fails on a host that other checks reach
broken-check.action: fix the check (its command, its address, its access); production is not touched

noise.name: noise
noise.signs: bots, scanners, paths that do not exist, one source with many lines

planned.name: planned
planned.signs: maintenance, a pause that a person set

dependency.name: outside dependency
dependency.signs: vendor errors, timeouts to one vendor address, the vendor's status page
dependency.action: one task, which waits on the vendor (blocked until the dependency check passes again); the faults of other checks meanwhile go to it as notes
dependency.never: a code fix during the outage

capacity.name: capacity
capacity.signs: disk, memory, connections, a quota or a rate limit
capacity.proof: df, the memory or the quota check is over its limit
capacity.action: the repair set in advance (maxpm ops repair), or a task for the person; then an ordinary task so that it does not happen again
capacity.never: a code fix for the errors that the full disk caused

service-down.name: service down
service-down.signs: a process stopped, a container restarts again and again
service-down.action: the restart repair set in advance (maxpm ops repair), at most ops_repair_max in ops_repair_window, then the person
service-down.never: more than the set number of restarts

expired.name: expired item
expired.signs: a certificate, a domain, a key or a token, a card at a vendor
expired.action: a task for the person, at once; then a scheduled task before the next expiry
expired.never: an agent that renews an account

configuration.name: configuration
configuration.signs: a missing setting or permission, a wrong address after a change
configuration.action: a task for the person or the manager
configuration.never: an agent that changes production settings

data.name: data
data.signs: one record or one customer's input causes the error
data.proof: the error follows one record or one workspace
data.action: a task to investigate; a change of production data only with the person's yes
data.never: a deletion without the person's yes

release-regression.name: release regression
release-regression.signs: it starts within the release window after a release; this fault did not occur before it
release-regression.proof: the first failed run comes after the release time
release-regression.action: propose the rollback at once; then an agent fixes the code, with a test that fails before the fix
release-regression.never: a fix while the bad release stays live and the rollback is cheap

code-defect.name: code defect
code-defect.signs: a repeated error with no other cause, a crash with a stack trace
code-defect.action: an agent fixes the code, with a test that fails before the fix, through normal review and release
code-defect.never: more fixes after 2 released fixes did not clear it: then the manager decides

unknown.name: unknown
unknown.action: one short sorting session gives a kind (maxpm ops kind) and adds the rule that would have found it
unknown.never: a code fix before a kind is given
